phases.name: Phase 01 — The honest axis is served: pure range rule in the core, y_range on both series reads (ADR-012, milestone-11)

steps.name: Pure range rule and the raw read that carries it
steps.description: CREATE core/axis.py — the three constants, a frozen AxisRange pair and y_axis_range(values) -> AxisRange | None, total, clock-free and order-invariant — with its paired Hypothesis property file, then serve the pair as an additive y_range key on GET /entries through one axis_range_wire helper beside entry_wire_pair. Owns the five raw-lens scenarios; the two empty-window scenarios assert BOTH lenses and are completed (and unskipped) by 01-02.
criteria: core/axis.py serves y_axis_range(values): None on no values; below FLOOR_KG (2.0) the band [mid − 1.0, mid + 1.0] with no extra pad; at or above it min − 0.1·span / max + 0.1·span; both bounds then snapped OUTWARD to GRID_KG (0.5) with ε = 1e-9, exact half-integer floats on the wire (76.5, never 76.49999)

The rule is total and order-invariant over any finite float sequence, reads no clock and performs no I/O; the three constants FLOOR_KG, GRID_KG, AUTO_PAD_FRACTION are defined in core/axis.py and nowhere else (import-linter core→shell/web contract and mypy strict stay green)

Paired Hypothesis property file tests/weight-trend-tracker/acceptance/properties/test_axis_range_properties.py pins the R-1 oracle: containment (lo ≤ min, max ≤ hi), hi − lo ≥ 2.0, both bounds ∈ 0.5·ℤ, floor-band width in [2.0, 3.0] with centre within 0.25 kg of the data midpoint, the exact ordinary formula at/above the floor, order invariance, None iff empty; @example rows for DESIGN § Range Rule 1–8 (incl. span exactly 2.0 ⇒ [75.5, 78.5] and three × 77.0 ⇒ [76.0, 78.0])

GET /entries answers y_range beside entries and invite_first_log — [lo, hi] over weight_kg of the windowed shown entries, null when the window is empty — phrased by one axis_range_wire(range) -> list[float] | None helper next to entry_wire_pair; entries and invite_first_log byte-identical; gap nulls never reach the rule

Scenarios owned (5, raw lens, unskipped by this step): A raw week is noise inside a band; Axis bounds are clean numbers; A lone entry still stands on an honest axis; A missing day stays a gap beneath the honest axis; Exactly two kilograms of movement is where the floor steps aside — all green with the full suite unregressed (219 shipped passes intact)

See nw-tdd-methodology::Paradigm Mandate for the full debt-payoff framing. — Crafter: nw-functional-software-crafter (pure functions over frozen dataclasses; effects only in the shell, ADR-005). THE one CREATE NEW of this feature (DESIGN Reuse Analysis): core/axis.py mirrors core/glance.py's shape — module docstring naming the ADR, constants at the top with a `#:` comment, one frozen @dataclass AxisRange(lo_kg: float, hi_kg: float), one public function, imports only from collections.abc/dataclasses (nothing from core.trend or core.types is needed — the rule takes VALUES, not entries, so it is lens-agnostic). Contract shape: pure-function (return-only), universe ∅. Signature pinned by ADR-012/D-27: y_axis_range(values: Sequence[float]) -> AxisRange | None. Arithmetic pinned by ADR-012 § Range Rule and mirrored by the test-side oracle expected_range in steps/composition.py (~line 2097) — implement TO it, never import it. Snap: lo = floor(2·lo₀ + 1e-9)/2, hi = ceil(2·hi₀ − 1e-9)/2; whether via math.floor or Decimal is the crafter's call, the @examples and the property are the contract. Branch boundary: span EXACTLY 2.0 is the ordinary branch (76.0/78.0 ⇒ [75.5, 78.5]). PBT file: tests/weight-trend-tracker/acceptance/properties/test_axis_range_properties.py in the test_trend_math_properties.py style (pytestmark property + us_015 marker — us_015 is already registered in pyproject.toml by DISTILL); strategies = lists of 0.1-precise floats in [30.0, 250.0] for raw plus arbitrary floats in that range for trend, sizes 0…60; @example rows 1–8 from DESIGN § Range Rule. routes.py: add axis_range_wire(range: AxisRange | None) -> list[float] | None directly beside entry_wire_pair (D-18 single-source precedent: the ONE place the pair becomes [lo, hi] / null), and one key on the history handler: "y_range": axis_range_wire(y_axis_range([e.weight_kg for e in shown])). Nothing else in the handler moves; ports.py untouched (WeightHistory gains no method — route-level enrichment on the glance/recent precedent). AT activation: remove @pending from exactly this step's 5 scenarios in tests/weight-trend-tracker/acceptance/milestone-11-honest-axis.feature (DISTILL authored them — never re-author; the RED anchor for each is an AssertionError at its first axis clause, red-classification.md). Do NOT unskip the two empty scenarios here — they assert `no axis is offered in either lens` and need /trend's y_range from 01-02. Run the full suite (uv run pytest -q) before COMMIT; commit via des-commit with all owned paths (axis.py, routes.py, the PBT file, the feature file). Mutation gate ≥80 % on core/axis.py + routes.py runs in Phase 5, not per step.

steps.name: The trend read carries the same axis
steps.description: GET /trend answers the same additive y_range key over trend_kg of the windowed points, through the same axis_range_wire helper — the rule's second and last consumer on the server. This completes the trend-lens scenarios, the G-3 frames-the-line guard, and the two empty scenarios whose `either lens` clause 01-01 could not satisfy. It also turns the lens × scale tour green, but that scenario's @pending is removed by 02-01, which owns it as its inherited regression clause.
criteria: GET /trend answers y_range beside points — [lo, hi] from y_axis_range over trend_kg of the windowed points, null when no point is in the window — phrased by the same axis_range_wire helper; points byte-identical to pre-feature (G-3: trend_series_in, windowing and ADR-004 constants untouched)

One rule, two reads: a 1M trend window of a wobbling 77.2 plateau answers [76.0, 78.5]; a steady 77.0 week answers [76.0, 78.0] in BOTH lenses (the ε rule — no spurious 75.5); the seeded 6M decline answers its padded range snapped outward with every bound on the half-kilogram grid
Nothing plotted ⇒ y_range is null with the key present, on /entries and /trend alike, for an empty window and for an empty record (invite_first_log still true on the empty record)

Both reads stay pure (ADR-009): no new event, no telemetry, the record and every frozen counter unchanged across any sequence of views; every load of the same window answers the identical points and the identical y_range

Scenarios owned (7, trend lens + both-lens closures, unskipped by this step): A stalled month reads flat; A real month of loss still slopes; A long window keeps its ordinary range, with clean edges; A perfectly steady week is a flat line, never a zero-height axis; The axis frames the line and never moves it; An empty window offers no axis; An empty record invites, and offers no axis — green with the full suite unregressed

phases.name: Phase 02 — The shared engine applies the served axis and the cached shell moves (D-31/D-32, milestone-11 close)

steps.name: The engine applies the served axis and computes nothing
steps.description: graph.js's renderChart takes a third argument yRange and adds scales: { y: { range: () => yRange } } only when the D-31 shape guard passes; showRaw/showTrend pass history.y_range / trend.y_range through. sw.js bumps SHELL_CACHE -v4 → -v5 because the pre-cached graph.js changed. There is no JS runner: this step's own RED anchor is a source-inspection unit test (test_axis_engine_wiring.py); its acceptance mapping is the lens × scale tour, an inherited GREEN-preserved regression clause the engine edit must leave green.
criteria: graph.js renderChart(data, lineOptionsFor, yRange) adds scales: { y: { range: () => yRange } } to the uPlot options only when yRange is an array of exactly two finite numbers with lo < hi; otherwise the scales key is omitted and uPlot's own range renders — an imperfect axis, never a blank chart

showRaw passes history.y_range and showTrend passes trend.y_range into renderChart; the engine holds no numeric literal for the floor, grid or pad (no standalone 2.0 / 0.5 / 0.1 as a range constant) and performs no range arithmetic — one definition (core), one consumer (the engine), both mounts

Source-inspection unit test tests/weight-trend-tracker/acceptance/properties/test_axis_engine_wiring.py (palette-guard precedent, test_entry_hint_wiring.py shape) is RED before and GREEN after: graph.js references y_range and wires it through scales / range behind the guard, carries no rule literal, and sw.js names weight-tracker-shell-v5 with APP_SHELL unchanged

sw.js SHELL_CACHE moves weight-tracker-shell-v4 → -v5 with the APP_SHELL list byte-identical; the shipped pin in test_date_row_dress.py that names -v4 is amended to -v5 as a documented inherited-test renegotiation (never silent), and no other shipped test moves

Inherited regression clause: 'Toggling lens or scale never changes the rule' (unskipped here, already green after 01-02) stays green through the engine edit; all 13 milestone-11 executions green with zero @pending; zero added fetches, scripts, origins, taps or telemetry (G-2/G-5/KPI-3)
